servers.name: Supabase MCP
recommendedWhen: The user explicitly chooses Supabase or the project already depends on Supabase.
The project needs development database/auth/storage access and the client can complete OAuth.
decisionWarnings: Do not infer Supabase from a generic database need; ask which provider first.
Prefer development or test projects and enable read-only mode where available.

postInstall: Authenticate through the MCP client OAuth flow.
Scope to a development project and enable read-only mode when possible.

servers.name: Stripe MCP
recommendedWhen: The user explicitly chooses Stripe and the project has a server-side payment boundary.
The integration plan includes webhook handling and no secret keys in client code.
decisionWarnings: Do not recommend Stripe MCP for a vague payment mention until the server-side boundary is confirmed.
Use OAuth or restricted keys; never write secret keys into repo config.

postInstall: Authenticate through OAuth when the client supports it.
If using a bearer token, store a restricted key in a secrets vault or environment variable.

servers.name: Notion MCP
recommendedWhen: The user explicitly wants Notion as the project knowledge base or content workspace.
decisionWarnings: Do not install by default for memory; filesystem Markdown remains the default project-memory surface.

postInstall: Authenticate with Notion through the client OAuth flow.

servers.name: Railway MCP
recommendedWhen: The user explicitly chooses Railway for deployment or the repo already contains Railway configuration.
decisionWarnings: Recommend only after deployment provider selection; do not infer Railway from generic hosting needs.

postInstall: Authenticate with Railway according to the selected client flow.

servers.name: Playwright MCP
recommendedWhen: The project needs browser or end-to-end verification and the client can run local stdio MCP servers.
decisionWarnings: Local browser automation may access local files, browser state, or network resources; keep it local-only unless a hosted adapter is designed.

postInstall: Install browsers in the local environment if the package prompts for them.

servers.name: MCP Memory Server
recommendedWhen: The user explicitly asks for local MCP memory and accepts local persistence behavior.
decisionWarnings: Do not use as the default project memory system until the repo has a written memory taxonomy and privacy boundary.
Never store secrets, private user data, or unresolved customer data in memory.

postInstall: Review the project memory taxonomy before writing persistent observations.

servers.name: GitHub MCP Server
recommendedWhen: The user asks for GitHub operations and the client does not already provide a GitHub connector.
decisionWarnings: Prefer an installed first-party client connector when available.
Any token must use least privilege and must not be written into repo files.

postInstall: Use a least-privilege token and prefer a dedicated development account or fine-grained token.

servers.name: CLI Printing Press
recommendedWhen: The user is researching generated CLI/MCP companion tooling and accepts a separate per-tool vetting step.
decisionWarnings: Do not auto-install generated tools from the library without per-tool provenance, license, and credential review.

postInstall: Treat as research input; create a separate install plan only after selecting a specific generated tool.
